note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Sparse-reward credit assignment problem -> SRPO reflection-based dense supervision -> results and ablations

nodes.name: Sparse terminal rewards give O(1) bits
nodes.description: Standard RL such as PPO and GRPO receives only terminal success/failure feedback per episode, about O(1) bits regardless of trajectory length, causing high-variance gradients and sample-inefficient learning on long-horizon tasks.

nodes.name: Existing reflection mechanisms are limited
nodes.description: Appending reflections within an ongoing trajectory induces semantic drift as context accumulates, and reflections conditioned on frozen parameters or injected prompts can disrupt native thinking.

nodes.name: Reflection generation (Stage 1)
nodes.description: SRPO has the model analyze a completed trajectory with its outcome and synthesize errors into a compact reflection patch.

nodes.name: Reset-with-memory
nodes.description: SRPO prepends the compact reflection patch to the original prompt and regenerates from a clean initial state, preserving task specification fidelity while injecting guidance.

nodes.name: Reflection-conditioned teacher is the same model
nodes.description: The teacher is the same model as the student operating with hindsight reflection, so no larger teacher, critic or separate reward model is needed.

nodes.name: Dense on-policy distillation (Stage 2)
nodes.description: SRPO teacher-forces the reflection-augmented teacher on the student's own rollouts and minimizes per-token reverse KL, yielding O(T) bits of token-level supervision while staying strictly on-policy.

nodes.name: Train with reflection, infer without
nodes.description: At inference the learned policy must reach comparable quality without any reflection, because the reflection guidance has been internalized through distillation.

nodes.name: SRPO AIME'24 and compute efficiency
nodes.description: With Qwen3-8B, SRPO reaches 73.3% on AIME'24 with 8% of the training FLOPs of scaled SFT, 3.3 points above standard on-policy distillation and 5.3 above GRPO.

nodes.name: Agentic benchmark results
nodes.description: SRPO reaches 64.7% on WebShop (+7.9% over SFT), 76.8% on ALFWorld (+5.6% over Reflexion) and 31.2% on SWE-Bench-Lite (+4.4% over Reflexion).

nodes.name: SRPO beats reflection-trained baselines
nodes.description: SRPO outperforms the reflection-trained baselines SCoRe, R3L and RISE.

nodes.name: Fewer total FLOPs than GRPO
nodes.description: Counting Stage 1 and 2, SRPO uses 5.4e18 FLOPs versus 20.8e18 for GRPO, about 3.8x fewer.

nodes.name: Self-distillation matches larger teacher
nodes.description: SRPO's self-distillation outperforms distillation from Qwen3-72B by 0.8 points while using 9x fewer teacher FLOPs.

nodes.name: Reflections are usually helpful
nodes.description: In a GPT-4 rating of 500 reflections, 67% score 4 or higher for helpfulness and only 8% score 2 or lower.

nodes.name: Reflection helpfulness correlates with improvement
nodes.description: Reflection helpfulness correlates with rethinking-rollout success improvement at r = 0.72; score-5 reflections give a 34% average improvement versus 5% for score 1-2.

nodes.name: Removing reflection hurts
nodes.description: Replacing reflection with a direct retry drops AIME'24 accuracy by 7.5 points.

nodes.name: State reset is essential
nodes.description: Appending reflections iteratively without state reset performs 7.0 points worse on AIME'24.

nodes.name: Reverse KL beats forward KL
nodes.description: Switching from reverse KL to forward KL drops AIME'24 accuracy by 3.9 points.

isolated_nodes.name: LoRA retains most performance
isolated_nodes.description: LoRA-128 reaches 97.8% of full fine-tuning accuracy on AIME'24 with 1.3% of the trainable parameters and 34% of the GPU memory.

isolated_nodes.name: Inference-time self-refinement gains
isolated_nodes.description: SRPO gains +1.8% per self-refinement iteration versus +1.2% for GRPO and +0.9% for SFT, reaching 78.5% on AIME'24 at 3 iterations.

isolated_nodes.name: Continual learning retention
isolated_nodes.description: In continual learning (math then coding), SRPO retains 95.2% of original math performance.

isolated_nodes.name: Failure modes of reflections
isolated_nodes.description: Unsuccessful reflections are generic advice (42%), incorrect diagnosis (35%) or beyond the model's capability (23%).

structural_reasoning: Credit-assignment motivation leads to the two-stage SRPO design; empirical results and ablations each tie to a specific mechanism component.
